works.body:
はじめまして。今回、私が遊んでいるネトゲのキャラクターを雨降夜さんに描いていただきたくて依頼しました。

資料：https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1d0Lg0t1aPKIHxfNfW4GwwNZLvpAJFJ9x?usp=sharing

アクセサリの干渉部分の解釈やポーズ、世界観やシチュエーション等は雨降夜さんの裁量に一任させていただきます。よろしくお願いします。

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1d0Lg0t1aPKIHxfNfW4GwwNZLvpAJFJ9x?usp=sharing

Hello! I would like to ask you to draw "Stella" from @_mpmbl's web novel "Nothing Short of a Miracle Quest"
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nxSurpHU4p-OVKi3cSfU3iVzfjC2GaLG?usp=sharing
I would love to see a drawing where Stella is in a dim forest at sunset pushing aside a shrub, revealing this monster (https://files.catbox.moe/t13tyr.png) (https://files.catbox.moe/ji0yr6.png) ahead of her. Kind of like this image (https://skeb.jp/@ao2is/works/11).
Otherwise, please draw as you like! Thank you!

Hi! I am a really big fan of your style. I'd love for you to draw my OC. Normally, she is a catgirl with blonde hair and blue eyes, however she has an evil split personality, which changes her physical appearance in many ways. I'd love for you to draw that split personality version of my character.

She has white hair and red eyes, as well as smudged eye makeup, an eyepatch on her left eye (right-side when facing her), and a thick scar across her mouth. You're free to draw that version of her in whichever way you'd like, including giving her any outfit you think is fitting. Normally, she smokes cigarettes as well, but it's up to you whether you'd like to draw her with one. I will provide references to everything!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WdCRogFUs6FJ0Ar51zzi9JiSQHJTNxnf?usp=sharing

Hi! i really love your art and wanted you to draw my vtuber! you can pick any pose! could you please draw the piece with a creepy scary feeling to it! My Character is a vampire bear! Character details: - VERY IMPORTANT: Please make sure to make the swirls on the face/cheeks very noticeable - Please do the correct Eye shape - Large Bust Size - vampire fangs -Bear ears -Vampire Bite Mark above collar bone area near neck - Talismen earring -Pupils are white in the shape of a bear head. Can the background and character please be separated in a PSD file https://drive.google.com/drive/u/3/folders/1RqBAvKvwVxED0B152t8LK1jgZIsqwkZo

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/3/folders/1RqBAvKvwVxED0B152t8LK1jgZIsqwkZo

Hello! I have recently come across some of your artwork and positively adore your artstyle! 
I would love it if you could draw a vtuber that I enjoy by the name of Para. She is a blue haired bunny girl that loves eating raw meat and is a little crazy. For this piece, I would like it if you could draw her mischievously smiling at the camera beside a tree as autumn leaves fall around her. 
She would be dressed in some sort of sweater and outfit suitable for autumn. 

There are several important details that must be included:
1. Her red eyes
2. Several bandages around her ears
3. She must be wearing glasses
4. If mouth is open to any degree, teeth must be pointed.

All other design decisions would be at your discretion.
The link below is her art tag which should give you many samples to help visualize her. Her twitter @ is @wwparasiVT.

Thank you!

https://x.com/search?q=%23parasiART&src=hashtag_click

雨降夜さん、こんばんは！
前回は素敵なうちの子を描いて頂きありがとうございました、誇張なしで毎日見て幸せでうっとりしています。
本当に雨降夜さんの描くお顔、色合い、モチーフの選び方、タッチ、全部が好みです……。
今回、また私の自作キャラクターを描いて頂きたくてリクエスト送らせて頂きました。

◾︎描いてほしいキャラクターの詳細
・鱗籠ほたるという女の子です。
蘇比陽島(そひなたしま)という自然が豊かで海がとても綺麗な島に住んでいます。ずっとそこにいるので世間知らずです。
・資料URL
https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/121973204
実は『海も枯れるまで』というクトゥルフ神話TRPGシナリオのHO2です。

◾︎使用用途
・SNSのアイコン、ヘッダーの使用
・スマホ、PCの壁紙に設定する
・自分の部屋に飾るためにプリントする

◾︎お願いしたいこと
・手書きで『ゆんさんへ』という宛名書きと雨降夜さまのサインがほしいです(ゆんへの敬称はなくてもどういったものでも大丈夫です、なくても全然構いません)

楽しく描いて頂けたら1番嬉しいです！
よろしくお願いいたします。

https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/121973204

Hello your Art looks really Beautiful and i would love to request one with my OC Maya.
The Pose and Expression is up to your Imagination.

OC Reference : https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xQlL6WwBscbg4KLoCG_09IudbZaSgr2b?usp=sharing
Outfit Reference : https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LQo72c6NsLeQrOL1IhPRl5rmG4MXgWxl?usp=sharing

Thank you so much!

I would like to request an illustration of "a human sleeping peacefully in a room with numerous human arms."

The inspiration is a sea anemone and a clownfish. The concept is to personify the scene of a sea anemone and a clownfish, surrounded by disturbing predatory organs, standing peacefully without being harmed.
The contrast between the disturbing and the peaceful is the main focus of this work. There is no particular need to color the sleeping humans' clothing in the color of bears. We leave everything to you except for the two conditions of "a room with many human arms" and "a person sleeping peacefully.

Thank you for your consideration.

■Requests

Original character illustration

■Details

Document: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FJTNirqaEhbyoS7DZ-gUxnIqdmoiuiNJ?usp=drive_link

Please check the material at your discretion and draw freely.
If possible, we would like you to draw them as a set, but if it is difficult, please draw only Shiranui.

■Usage

Creation of goods for personal viewing.
Use for social networking icons and headers with your name clearly written.

If there is any shortage in the amount, please resend.
Thank you for your consideration.

Hi, I have been a fan of your illustrations since I saw them on tiktok! I love everything about your illustrations, from the way you draw the lines to the colors you use, not to mention your worldview. I would like to send you a request to draw my OC this time.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-7RtZ446f53d2POrUCHbnNminLXn1J-D

I am a girl who is a floating spirit.
She died in an unfortunate accident when she was 14 years old.
She does not understand that she is dead and wanders around in this world, but she seems to be enjoying her life more freely than expected.
She loves butterflies and often plays in the forest. She also likes sweets.

I am happy to leave everything to you, including composition and facial expressions, so I would appreciate it if you could draw it as you like. I am sorry for your busy schedule, but I would appreciate your consideration!

雨降夜さん、こんにちは！   いつもイラストをTwitterで見ています、創作イラストも版権イラストもどちらも好きです！   解説のツイートも大好きです。

良ければ私のオリジナルキャラクターを描いて頂きたいです。

リクエスト内容
◾︎創作キャラクターの「スターチス」を描いて頂きたいです。8歳の女の子です。
両親に望まれて愛されて育った女の子ですが、8歳の誕生日に誘拐されて亡くなってしまった設定があります。
母親が手作りしてくれた猫のぬいぐるみが大好きです！他はアイスクリームが好きです。

資料1

https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/92612144

資料2

https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/118587636

お願いしたいこと
◾︎可能であればPSD形式をお願いしたいです。
◾︎もし良ければ手書きで「ゆんさん」(敬称はなくてもなんでもいいです)と、サインを書いて頂きたいです。
◾︎服装は普段着で、暗い雰囲気で描いて頂けたら嬉しいです。

使用用途
◾︎SNS(Twitter(X)、Misskey、discord)等のアイコン、ヘッダー使用(使用する際はクレジットを記載します)
◾︎スマホ、PCでの壁紙使用(こちら比率など気にしないで描いて頂いて大丈夫です)
◾︎プリントして部屋に飾る

以上となります。ご検討のほど、よろしくお願いいたします。

I saw "Akari Akari Sheep" by Ameya and liked it very much, so I would like to make a request.

I would like you to draw Akari Kizoboshi as a deformed girl whose forearms have been transformed into dragon's jaws.
The dragon's jaw is black like a shadow, and the five eyes are yellow like the moon. The border between the forearm in the dragon's jaw and the upper arm in the human form can be clear or blurred.
Akari is smiling and extending her arm as if to point the muzzle of a gun at an off-screen figure. The off-screen target is sitting down, probably begging for his life. Akari is probably thinking about dinner and is not paying attention to the target.
The background should be dark, like "Akari Akari the Sheep".

(I have also prepared a reference image, but it was prepared by a person with no artistic ability, so it may be useless to even look at it. https://imgur.com/a/5Ypgush)

It is nice to meet you. I always enjoy looking at your wonderful illustrations.
I would like to send you a request to draw my original character for this trip.

There are folders for multiple characters in the resource URL, but I would like an illustration of the girl as a single character. The character will have black hair and pigtails.
If the design is ambiguous, please feel free to simplify it.

We would appreciate it if you could refer to the materials and rough drafts in the other folders for the facial expressions and atmosphere.

We like the worldview of your illustrations very much, so we will leave all compositions and situations to you.

I would appreciate it if you could resend or cancel the request if there are any discrepancies in the amount or the details of the request.
I would appreciate your consideration.

https://www.dropbox.com/sh/jabipjf23h3nxph/AABHXwJQLSen-4rmDT6jfoLma?dl=0
